integrity: All iteration claims follow from explicit induction and softmax asymptotics. Standalone finite replay supports the proof. Earlier overrelaxed Sinkhorn and related splitting methods are distinguished, but historical priority remains non-exhaustive. No independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic positive product initializations and column-additive costs. The objective is constant on the feasible polytope; no universal behavior for general nonadditive costs, finite-precision arithmetic, or algorithmic cost is established.
title: Sharp multiplier-step boundary for logarithmic-dual Bregman ADMM on additive-cost transport
